guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Diamond Light Source
guides.concept: 以 Diamond 的 3 GeV、561.6 m、24 單元雙彎消色散儲存環為對象，從 499.68 MHz 射頻與 936 個束團桶出發，理解中能量光源如何靠真空內波盪器的高次諧波取得硬 X 光、如何管理前端熱負載，再推導 Diamond-II 把能量提高到 3.5 GeV 並換成 DTBA 晶格後，發射度、光子能量與光束線必須同步調整的工程邏輯。
guides.conceptEn: Using Diamond's 3 GeV, 561.6 m, 24-cell double-bend achromat ring, start from the 499.68 MHz RF and 936 buckets to see how a medium-energy source reaches hard X-rays through the high harmonics of in-vacuum undulators and manages front-end heat load, then derive why Diamond-II's move to 3.5 GeV and a DTBA lattice forces emittance, photon energy and beamlines to be re-engineered together.
procedure: 儲存環的周長與射頻頻率決定諧波數 h = C/λ_RF，也就是能放束團的桶數；Diamond 周長 561.571 m、射頻 499.680 MHz，迴轉頻率 533.8 kHz，最多 936 個束團，相鄰束團間隔 2 ns。1.4 T 的彎轉磁鐵決定臨界能量與每圈的輻射損失，而 300 mA 的儲存電流決定射頻系統必須送進束流的功率。使用者看到的時間結構（混合填充、單束團模式）全由這組參數定義。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「3 GeV 儲存環與 499.68 MHz 射頻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Diamond 原始晶格是 24 單元雙彎消色散，水平發射度 3.14 nm·rad，垂直 8 pm·rad。發射度隨 γ²θ³ 變化：Diamond-II 一方面把能量提高到 3.5 GeV（γ² 增加 36%），另一方面以雙三彎消色散（DTBA）把每單元彎轉數從 2 增到 6，θ³ 的縮減遠勝 γ² 的增加，同時在單元中段多出一個直線段，讓原本的彎轉磁鐵光束線改由短插件供光。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「DBA 晶格與 Diamond-II DTBA 晶格」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

中能量環要取得硬 X 光，依賴短週期真空內波盪器與高次諧波。NdFeB 永磁與釩鐵鈷極頭組成的混合式磁列放在真空腔內，間隙可關到 5 mm；峰值磁場隨間隙近似指數下降，偏轉參數 K = 0.934·B₀[T]·λ_u[cm] 決定基頻波長與各諧波的相對強度。基頻與奇數諧波在軸上最強，相位誤差則優先削弱高次諧波，所以磁列的機械精度直接換成硬 X 光通量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「真空內波盪器（λ_u = 23 mm）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

射頻腔不只補回每圈損失，還以電壓高度決定縱向的射頻桶大小，也就是動量接受度；Touschek 散射讓束團內電子互相把能量踢出接受度，壽命對接受度非常敏感。Diamond 以 936 個束團高電流運轉，腔體的高階模（HOM）會驅動耦合束團不穩定，因此 Diamond-II 採用高階模阻尼的常溫腔。同步振盪頻率是檢驗電壓與動量壓縮因子的直接量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「射頻腔、電壓與動量接受度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Diamond 在彎轉磁鐵光口用 X 光針孔相機成像束流：針孔把光源投影到螢幕，影像寬度包含束流尺寸乘放大率、針孔繞射與幾何模糊、螢幕與鏡頭的點擴散。垂直發射度只有 8 pm·rad，束流只有十幾微米，所以必須先獨立量出系統點擴散函數再做平方相減；水平方向則還要扣除色散與能散的貢獻，否則發射度會被高估。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「X 光針孔相機與發射度量測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

300 mA 下一支波盪器的總功率達數千瓦，軸上功率密度達數十 kW/mrad²；前端的固定光闌與可動吸收器先截掉大部分功率，第一片矽晶體仍要承受數百瓦。晶體的熱變形正比於熱膨脹係數除以熱導率（α/k），矽在液氮溫度附近 α 趨近零而 k 大幅上升，所以第一晶體以液氮冷卻，把熱凸起造成的斜率誤差壓到微弧度級，保住單色器的能量解析與光束位置。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「前端吸收器與低溫矽單色器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Diamond-II 在同一隧道內更換整座儲存環，前提是保住既有光束線的光源點位置與方向，否則前端與光學全部重建。能量從 3 提高到 3.5 GeV 後，每支波盪器在相同間隙下的光子能量全部上移 36%，光束線若要維持原工作能量，必須改變 K 值（縮小間隙）或更換磁列週期；DTBA 晶格新增的中段直線段則讓原本的彎轉磁鐵光束線改接短插件，光源特性整個改變。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「同一隧道換環：光源點與光束線匹配」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收一座使用者設施不只看峰值參數，還要看頂注運轉是否把電流維持在窄帶內、每年排定的使用者時數中有多少真正供光、以及故障後多快恢復。頂注的頻率由壽命與允許的電流變化決定；可用度由平均故障間隔與平均修復時間決定，而每次注入的束流損失與輻射劑量也要列入紀錄，讓光束線的熱負載、劑量與資料品質可以追溯。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「機器驗收與可用度紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Circumference and RF frequency fix the harmonic number h = C/λ_RF, the number of buckets that can hold bunches: Diamond has C = 561.571 m, RF at 499.680 MHz, a revolution frequency of 533.8 kHz, up to 936 bunches and a 2 ns spacing between neighbours. The 1.4 T dipoles set the critical energy and the radiation loss per turn, while the 300 mA stored current sets the power the RF system must deliver to the beam. Every time structure users see, hybrid fills or single-bunch mode, is defined by this parameter set. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “3 GeV ring and 499.68 MHz RF”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Diamond's original lattice is a 24-cell double-bend achromat with 3.14 nm·rad horizontal and 8 pm·rad vertical emittance. Emittance scales as γ²θ³: Diamond-II raises the energy to 3.5 GeV, a 36% increase in γ², but the double-triple-bend achromat (DTBA) raises the bends per cell from 2 to 6, and the θ³ reduction far outweighs the γ² increase, while a new mid-cell straight lets former bending-magnet beamlines be fed by short insertion devices. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “DBA lattice and the Diamond-II DTBA lattice”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A medium-energy ring reaches hard X-rays through short-period in-vacuum undulators and their high harmonics. A hybrid array of NdFeB magnets and vanadium-permendur poles sits inside the vacuum chamber so the gap can close to 5 mm; the peak field falls roughly exponentially with gap, and the deflection parameter K = 0.934·B₀[T]·λ_u[cm] sets the fundamental wavelength and the relative strength of each harmonic. The fundamental and odd harmonics are strongest on axis, and phase errors weaken the high harmonics first, so the mechanical precision of the array converts directly into hard X-ray flux. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “In-vacuum undulator (λ_u = 23 mm)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

RF cavities do more than restore the loss per turn: the voltage sets the height of the longitudinal RF bucket, that is the momentum acceptance, and Touschek scattering inside each bunch kicks electrons out of that acceptance, so lifetime is very sensitive to it. Diamond runs 936 bunches at high current, where cavity higher-order modes (HOMs) drive coupled-bunch instabilities, which is why Diamond-II adopts HOM-damped normal-conducting cavities. The synchrotron frequency is the direct check of voltage and momentum compaction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “RF cavities, voltage and momentum acceptance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Diamond images the beam through an X-ray pinhole camera on a bending-magnet port: the pinhole projects the source onto a screen, and the image width contains the beam size times magnification, pinhole diffraction and geometric blur, and the point spread of screen and lens. With only 8 pm·rad vertical emittance the beam is a dozen micrometres, so the system point-spread function must be measured independently and subtracted in quadrature; horizontally the dispersion and energy-spread contribution must also be removed or emittance is overestimated. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “X-ray pinhole camera and emittance measurement”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

At 300 mA one undulator radiates several kilowatts in total with an on-axis power density of tens of kW/mrad²; fixed masks and movable absorbers in the front end strip most of it, but the first silicon crystal still takes hundreds of watts. Crystal thermal deformation scales with thermal expansion over conductivity (α/k), and near liquid-nitrogen temperature silicon's α approaches zero while k rises sharply, so the first crystal is cooled with liquid nitrogen to keep the slope error of the thermal bump at the microradian level, preserving monochromator energy resolution and beam position. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Front-end absorbers and cryogenic silicon monochromator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Diamond-II replaces the entire storage ring inside the same tunnel, which only works if the source positions and directions of existing beamlines are preserved; otherwise front ends and optics would all be rebuilt. With energy raised from 3 to 3.5 GeV every undulator's photon energy at a given gap shifts up by 36%, so a beamline that must keep its working energy has to change K by closing the gap or replace the array period; the new mid-cell straights of the DTBA lattice let former bending-magnet beamlines be fed by short insertion devices, changing their source properties entirely. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Same-tunnel ring replacement: source points and beamline matching”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Accepting a user facility is not only about peak parameters: it covers whether top-up holds the current in a narrow band, how many of the scheduled user hours actually deliver light, and how fast the machine recovers after a fault. Top-up frequency follows from lifetime and the allowed current variation; availability follows from mean time between failures and mean time to repair, and the beam loss and radiation dose of every injection are logged so that beamline heat load, dose and data quality remain traceable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Machine acceptance and availability record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若周長因地基沉降改變而射頻頻率未跟隨，束流被迫走離能軌道，能量偏移經色散轉成軌道偏移，所有光束線的光子能量同時微幅漂移，卻沒有任何單一設備報警。
把影像寬度直接除以放大率而不扣點擴散，垂直發射度會被報成兩倍以上；若螢光屏因輻射老化而變厚、變模糊，同一算法會讓發射度看起來隨時間變差，其實束流根本沒變。
pitfallsEn: If the circumference changes through ground settlement and the RF frequency does not follow, the beam is forced onto an off-energy orbit, the energy offset turns into an orbit offset through dispersion, and the photon energy on every beamline drifts slightly at once without any single device raising an alarm.

Dividing the image width by the magnification without subtracting the point spread reports vertical emittance more than twice too high; if the scintillator thickens and blurs with radiation ageing, the same algorithm makes emittance appear to degrade over time while the beam has not changed at all.

related.title: 歐洲同步輻射設施 ESRF
related.transfer: 可遷移「儲存環時序：射頻諧波數與束團結構」與「束流尺寸、點擴散函數與發射度反推」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；歐洲同步輻射設施 ESRF的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Ring timing: RF harmonic number and bunch structure" and "Beam size, point-spread function and emittance inversion" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of European Synchrotron Radiation Facility must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦3 GeV 中能量儲存環的射頻、插件磁鐵、熱負載與 Diamond-II 升級工程；歐洲同步輻射設施 ESRF則以6 GeV HMBA 儲存環的發射度、亮度與軌道穩定工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on RF, insertion devices, heat load and the Diamond-II upgrade of a 3 GeV medium-energy ring; European Synchrotron Radiation Facility centres on emittance, brilliance and orbit-stability engineering of the 6 GeV HMBA storage ring, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「3 GeV 儲存環與 499.68 MHz 射頻」與「6 GeV 儲存環與彎轉磁鐵輻射」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到歐洲同步輻射設施 ESRF，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「亮度、同調分率與繞射極限」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “3 GeV ring and 499.68 MHz RF” and “6 GeV ring and bending-magnet radiation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to European Synchrotron Radiation Facility, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Brilliance, coherent fraction and the diffraction limit", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.difference: 本課聚焦3 GeV 中能量儲存環的射頻、插件磁鐵、熱負載與 Diamond-II 升級工程；台灣同步輻射光源 TLS則以1.5 GeV、120 m TBA 儲存環的能量提升、超導插件、超導射頻、頂注穩定、地層監測與雙光源分工為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on RF, insertion devices, heat load and the Diamond-II upgrade of a 3 GeV medium-energy ring; Taiwan Light Source centres on energy upgrade, superconducting insertion devices, SRF, top-up stability, ground monitoring and dual-source division in a 1.5 GeV, 120 m TBA ring, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「3 GeV 儲存環與 499.68 MHz 射頻」與「18 台偶極磁鐵（ρ = 3.495 m）」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到台灣同步輻射光源 TLS，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「TPS 施工期間的地層變形監測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “3 GeV ring and 499.68 MHz RF” and “18 dipoles with ρ = 3.495 m”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Taiwan Light Source, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Ground-deformation monitoring during TPS construction", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施
history.text: Diamond Light Source 位於英國牛津郡 Harwell 科學園區，由英國科學與技術設施委員會與 Wellcome 基金會共同出資，2007 年初開放使用者，是英國的國家級同步輻射光源，以 3 GeV、24 單元雙彎消色散儲存環運轉，並於 2000 年代後期陸續建成三十多條光束線。Diamond-II 升級計畫於 2020 年代獲得核准，將以雙三彎消色散晶格把能量提高到 3.5 GeV 並大幅降低發射度，同時保留既有光束線的光源點。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Diamond Light Source sits on the Harwell science campus in Oxfordshire, funded jointly by the UK Science and Technology Facilities Council and the Wellcome Trust; it opened to users in early 2007 as the UK's national synchrotron, running a 3 GeV, 24-cell double-bend achromat ring and building more than thirty beamlines through the late 2000s and 2010s. The Diamond-II upgrade, approved in the 2020s, will raise the energy to 3.5 GeV with a double-triple-bend achromat lattice and cut emittance sharply while preserving the source points of existing beamlines. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「儲存環時序：射頻諧波數與束團結構」到「頂注運轉、可用度與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Ring timing: RF harmonic number and bunch structure" through "Top-up operation, availability and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
